xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5185: File explorer A: server core (contracts, roots, read, git, search, watcher child)

plan.title: File explorer A: server core (contracts, roots, read, git, search, watcher child)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This is child A of the PAN-5183 file explorer, which the parent PRD already decomposed into seven sibling issues (PAN-5185 to PAN-5191). It is the server foundation every sibling depends on: the full RPC contract (which must land as one unit because PanRpcGroup.of and the no-loss matrix require every method at once), root and path safety, the read/git/search services and the watcher process boundary. The file count comes from one test file per module and from WI-17 assets (license copies, a script, a JSON file) that the subsystem counter scores as separate subsystems. Splitting further would leave siblings depending on several fragments with no change in reviewability, since the items are already small and separately verifiable.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no server API to list a project's directories, read arbitrary files under a root safely, report git status per path, search a tree, or watch it for changes. The file explorer (PAN-5183) needs all of this before any UI can be built, and @parcel/watcher must never run inside the dashboard process (PAN-4193 froze it).
narratives.Proposal: Add packages/contracts/src/explorer.ts and the 14 pan.explorer* RPCs (7 read handlers implemented here, 7 stubs answering NOT_IMPLEMENTED for PAN-5187/PAN-5191). Add services under src/dashboard/server/services/explorer/: root resolution and path safety (project roots read-only, strict workspace isolation rule, .git write guard ported from t3code), a single git runner with literal pathspecs and no optional locks, listDir/readFile, git status/stage/unstage/discard (discard never deletes new files), fuzzy file search and git-grep content search, and a forked @parcel/watcher child with Orca-ported batching and ignore regex, supervised with heartbeat, restart, per-root and global poll fallback. Enforce the process boundary at build time. Add the upstream port-record script, licenses and records for this issue's ports, and document it in DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md. The full executable spec is .pan/drafts/pan-5185.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Any frontend code: no pane, tree, editor or viewer (PAN-5186 onward).
- Write services, the Overdeck trash, and discard of files not in HEAD (PAN-5187); this issue never deletes a file and never runs rm or git clean.
- HTTP routes, downloads and uploads (PAN-5188); no ROUTE_SCOPES rows.
- Edit workspaces, a real explorerBeginEdit handler, and PRs (PAN-5191).
- RPC_METHOD_SCOPES entries; new methods stay admin-only.
- Setting isDirectory or emitting rename events from the watcher.
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap.
- Importing @parcel/watcher anywhere except watch-child.ts, or spawning any process from the watcher child.
- Sorting directory listings on the server.

autoDecisions.summary: Register all 14 explorer RPCs now; the 7 owned by PAN-5187/PAN-5191 get stub handlers that fail with NOT_IMPLEMENTED (D-A1).
autoDecisions.rationale: PanRpcGroup.of requires a handler per Rpc and parent AC-1 requires all 14 in the group; stubs give sibling issues a fixed contract and fail loudly instead of silently.

autoDecisions.summary: Add all 14 no-loss-matrix rows here, READ for read methods and WRITE for the rest (D-A2).
autoDecisions.rationale: no-loss-matrix.test.ts scans rpc.ts, so any WS_METHODS value without a row turns CI red; the file has no NEW disposition.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve issue roots through resolveProjectFromIssue then getWorkspacePathForIssue(projectPath, id) (D-A3).
autoDecisions.rationale: getWorkspacePathForIssue takes two arguments; readWorkspaceFile already uses this exact sequence.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept workspace:<id> roots only under the derived isolation rule in D-A4.
autoDecisions.rationale: WorkspaceRow has no isolated flag and a non-isolated scratch row points at the primary checkout; accepting it would make the primary writable, breaking parent D-6.

autoDecisions.summary: Port the Orca signature over the UTF-8-decoded string, not bytes; vectors computed from Orca's own file (D-A5).
autoDecisions.rationale: Orca hashes UTF-16 code units; porting unchanged keeps parity, and the signature is opaque to clients.

autoDecisions.summary: Treat stage/unstage/discard as writes (forWrite) and refuse discard of paths not in HEAD with NOT_IMPLEMENTED until PAN-5187 ships the trash (D-A7).
autoDecisions.rationale: They mutate the index or worktree; deleting untracked files without the trash would be unrecoverable, and the trash belongs to WI-11.

autoDecisions.summary: Run every explorer git call through one runner with --literal-pathspecs and GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 (D-A8).
autoDecisions.rationale: Pathspec magic would make discard/stage act on unintended files, and optional locks contend with agents running git in the same worktree.

autoDecisions.summary: Use async project lookups (listProjectsAsync, defaultBranchForRepo, resolveBaseRef) instead of the parent's sync helpers (D-A9).
autoDecisions.rationale: NFR-1 forbids sync calls reachable from the dashboard server.

autoDecisions.summary: Compute committed against resolveBaseRef(default branch) with a three-dot name-status diff (D-A10).
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing vs-main diff panel, so the Changed filter keeps FilesPane's meaning; the parent's WI-14 lookup belongs to a later issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Use Orca's anchored regex via ignoreGlobs for watcher ignores, not **/name/** globs (D-A11).
autoDecisions.rationale: Orca documents pathological regex costs for leading-** globs; a probe showed the regex prunes ignored trees to the same 5 watches as globs.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not set isDirectory or emit rename from the watcher (D-A12).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parcel reports only create/update/delete; clients re-list parents on any event, and rename inference belongs to PAN-5187.

autoDecisions.summary: Port records only for signature.ts, watch-batch.ts, watch-ignore.ts and git-dir-guard.ts (D-A13).
autoDecisions.rationale: Only those files copy upstream logic; idioms do not warrant a record.

autoDecisions.summary: Validate port records with upstream-port-diff.sh --check in npm run lint, tested from tests/unit/scripts/ (D-A14).
autoDecisions.rationale: scripts/__tests__ is outside the vitest include; a script check needs no upstream checkout and runs in CI lint.

autoDecisions.summary: Enforce NFR-2 with a tsdown writeBundle assertion plus a local slow test; move the live tree checks of parent AC-3/AC-4 to PAN-5186 (D-A15, D-A16).
autoDecisions.rationale: This issue has no UI; a build assertion is mechanical and the slow test proves the process boundary with real parcel.
changelog.d/README.md requires an entry only for user-noticeable changes; nothing here is visible.

autoDecisions.summary: Add NOT_IMPLEMENTED, INVALID_QUERY and EXPLORER_FAILED to the explorer error codes (D-A18).
autoDecisions.rationale: Stubs, invalid regex queries and unexpected failures each need a code clients can branch on.

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Creates only git.ts and its test; read-service and search-service touch disjoint new files.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-A6 and D-A6, D-A7, D-A10. gitStatus: rev-parse --show-prefix (fail → NOT_A_GIT_REPO), status --porcelain=v2 -z --branch --untracked-files=normal, parse records 1/2/u/?/! and # branch.head exactly as specified, the X/Y mapping, prefix stripping, 20000-entry cap; committed via resolveBaseRef(root.absPath, root.defaultBranch) and diff --name-status -z -M base...HEAD (empty for project roots). gitStage: first require rev-parse --show-prefix to be empty (non-zero exit or non-empty prefix → NOT_A_GIT_REPO, so an enclosing repo is never touched), then resolve every path forWrite; stage = add, unstage = restore --staged, discard = ls-tree HEAD check then restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree; any path not in HEAD makes the whole discard fail with NOT_IMPLEMENTED before any git command. Never rm, never git clean.

Given a file literally named "*.txt" and an unstaged a.txt, when gitStage stage(["*.txt"]) runs, then only "*.txt" becomes staged

Given a project-kind root, when gitStage stage(["a.txt"]) runs, then it rejects with EDIT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED; given an issue-kind root that is a subdirectory of a repo, then it rejects with NOT_A_GIT_REPO and the enclosing repo index stays unchanged

metadata.acJustification: Six ACs: the supervisor has six independent failure behaviors (ref counting, heartbeat restart, poll mode, per-root polling, idle stop, real-process isolation) and each needs its own observable check.
